content.comment_body: Hello, I'm unable to open the program I created with [product_name]. After making some changes and saving the file, I now get an error saying it's not a FBD diagram. Any advice would be appreciated.

I'm experiencing a similar issue, but the error says the file is not a LAD diagram. Although it's saved with the correct .lld extension and programmed in [product_name] V[version_no], I can't open it. I've tried renaming, saving, and opening from my desktop as well as directly from within [product_name], but the error persists. EDIT: I've attached the file in ZIP format as requested.
Could you please upload your program as a ZIP file?
Could you please upload your program as a ZIP file?
I've attached the file to my original post, hope that's acceptable. I'll add it here again just in case.

If you edit a post after it's published, I won't receive an email notification about the update. Posting a new reply and attaching your program is better, as it triggers a notification for new posts in the topic.
It seems your program file might be corrupted. Please consider starting a Support Request with [company_name] to see if they can help recover the file.

Hi! I'm facing the same issue. I noticed I created the software with Version [version_no], but tried opening with an older version ([version_no]). This caused the same error: '... is not a FBD diagram ...'. Kind regards from Italy

It seems you selected hardware Version [version_no]. In this case, you can't open the program with [product_name] V[version_no] (or older), resulting in the error message: '... it's not a FBD diagram, please check it.'
I followed the suggestion and tried opening with [product_name] V[version_no], and it worked.
Hello [user_name], English is preferred in this forum. Please post in English. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing significant difficulties reopening projects saved in [product_name], especially when opening files created in newer software versions with older versions. The errors indicate the file is not recognized as an FBD or LAD diagram. There is frustration about possible file damage and uncertainty regarding file recovery options.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to reliably access and edit previously saved programs in [product_name] without encountering compatibility or corruption errors. There is also an expectation for clearer error guidance and better recovery options from the software.
